record_title: Sharp local and diffuse distinguishability for Bernoulli mirror products
limitations: The sharp interval is local in total squared signal; the finite-signal efficiency curve requires a diffuse triangular array with maximal coordinate tending to zero; no convergence rate is claimed for that array; the globally optimal constant in the source mirror-product theorem remains unresolved; classical LAN and Khintchine theory are prior art; older binary-experiment and Riesz-product literature was not exhaustively inspected; independent audit has not been performed.
